182895.overview:
Miner Willy fell into a forgotten mine shaft near Surbiton and discovered a network of underground caverns left by an advanced (but now extinct) civilization. Collect all treasures before your air runs out while watching out for the nasty robotic guardians and deadly obstacles.

This is the SAM Coupé version of the classic platformer Manic Miner, remade from scratch (enhanced graphics, stereo soundtrack), with 40 new levels in addition to the original set of 20.

184219.overview:
If shooting aliens is not your idea of fun then these are the games for you. In this pack are four games that rely on quick wits and fast thinking rather than an itchy trigger finger.

These games contain puzzles and problems that will have you coming back time and time again to try to beat them. Presented in an arcade style they increase in difficulty so that the whole family can get involved and have fun.

NUCLEAR WASTE

You can help save the Earth by getting rid of the dangerous nuclear waste. Your quick thinking will get the spaceship loaded and launched before the canisters can do any damage.

MAGIC CAVES

Careful planning is needed if you are to collect all of the magic potions and escape from the caves. It will take a lot of thought if you are to get to the highest levels.

BLOKADE

A computer game that will take all of your concentration to solve. Try to change all of the colours on the board by using the ingenious method of control. Each level gets faster and faster and will have your pulse racing.

BOMBED OUT

Choose your route around the screen carefully as you may find yourself trapped with an exploding bomb! Collect bonus flags and avoid the skull and crossbones.

184220.overview:
Following the success of the first Mind Games compilation, Enigma Variations are pleased to present four more games of skill that rely on brain power, not a fast trigger finger!

QUINTET

A computerised dice game that involves some careful decision making.

LINE UP

A fiendishly tricky game of 3D noughts and crosses that will give even the best of players a run for their money!

PIXSAW

This is the famous sliding blocks game brought up to date on your computer. If you think solving a four by four block puzzle is difficult, wait until you try level 2 with eight by eight blocks!

FLIP-IT

A challenging game of skill and forward planning based on the classic Othello game.

459491.overview:
Moby DX is an enhanced version of the developer's previous title, The Lost Disks of Sam. The game has four bonus power ups: speedup, invulnerability, enemy freeze and extra lives. It comprises 8 levels and runs at a solid 50fps. A couple of new (to SAM) enemy types, a better looking snake and rewritten bomb plus some other fancy touch ups here and there. 

The game is available from the developer's website, http://blackjet.co.uk/ and was first published on the cover disk of SAM Revival issue 25.

459601.overview:
'Inspired' by the classic 8-bit game, Spindizzy.

Prevent an invasion of earth by finding and collecting 365 alien eggs among an extensive isometrically viewed 3D landscape.

459856.overview:
Magic Caves 2002 is an enhanced version of Magic Caves from the 1990 released Enigma Varaitions compilation, Mind Games 1.

Developed by Dave Tonks, it combines elements of puzzle-solving with traditional platforming mechanics.

Players navigate through intricate cave systems, collecting items and avoiding obstacles. Each level presents unique challenges requiring strategic movement and timing to progress.

460135.overview:
Mines of Magrathea is a game set within the universe of Douglas Adams' famous series. Players take on the role of Ford Prefect, who must navigate the perilous mines of Magrathea to repay a massive debt. The goal is to collect bags of money while avoiding invisible mines that become visible only for a brief moment.

The game is a unique blend of strategy and memory challenge, as players must remember the locations of mines after they disappear. Each level introduces more mines, increasing the difficulty and requiring quick thinking to avoid disaster.

Developed for the SAM Coupé, the game was originally a Spectrum version by Paul E. Collins. Jim Waterman upgraded it for the 2022 CSSCGC competition, adding new features and enhancements that leverage the SAM Coupé's capabilities.

The storyline involves Ford's reckless spending with a stolen Dine-O-Charge card, leading to a debt of over a million Altairian dollars. With the Vogons on his trail, Ford's only hope is to gather enough money from the Magrathean mines to settle his debts and escape their wrath.
